topic.title: New Towns / Development Corporations / Programme Delivery
topic.source_contract: programme and location status, designation, development corporation, approved proposals, land assembly, infrastructure plan, planning policy, environmental assessment, funding, consents, phasing, construction, occupation and long-term delivery evidence

scope_guards: A draft programme location is not treated as a confirmed new town.
Consultation material is not treated as adopted planning policy.
A designation proposal is not treated as a made designation order.
A development corporation is not treated as owner of all required land.
Approved proposals are not treated as planning consent.
A funding ambition is not treated as a signed settlement.
Construction targets are not treated as occupied homes.
No score or promotion is written without final programme, designation, land, funding, consent, construction and occupation evidence.
